title: filosofos: with semaphores
summary: Dining philosophers without deadlock, using one semaphore per chopstick.
hints: Five semaphores, one per chopstick, all starting at 1. Philosopher `i` needs chopsticks `i` and `(i + 1) % 5`.

If everybody takes the left one first they can all hold one and wait forever. Break the cycle: take the chopstick with the LOWER number first (or let only 4 philosophers sit at the table, with one more semaphore).
